linkedPullRequests.title: Fixed ip6table internal_docker_ip_traffic rule command for multi-asic
linkedPullRequests.author: anamehra
linkedPullRequests.body:
Signed-off-by: anamehra <anamehra@cisco.com>

Fixes: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/17431

The self.namespace_docker_mgmt_ipv6[namespace] variable was being used as a string causing the cmd to fail.
Fixed the command.
